description: Settings navigation shared by Orb desktop (orb/src/settingsNav.ts), iOS (OrbSettingsNav.swift) and Android (SettingsNav.kt): five sections in this order, each with a one-line subtitle and its tabs. Tab ids are page ids; pages are reachable by id without a tab (usage details, opened from Providers, which is the one place for quotas); legacy maps ids that lost their own page. A section shows an attention dot: security when Fleet Bunker Mode is active or this device can approve but is not enrolled; models when a provider quota is exhausted.

sections.label: Account
sections.subtitle: Your server connection, connected accounts and how Orb looks.

sections.label: Models
sections.subtitle: Which models agents use and in what order when a provider is unavailable.

sections.label: Agents
sections.subtitle: What agents know and can do, the Assistant, and the agents on this computer.

sections.label: Security
sections.subtitle: Who can approve risky actions, Fleet Bunker Mode, privileged access and secrets.

sections.subtitle: What reaches your Inbox and when Orb tells you.
